chapter_name: A Tale of Three Intersecting Lines
learning_objective: 🎯 Understand how three crisscrossing lines give birth to the most stable shape in the universe: the mighty triangle!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When three straight lines intersect each other at three different points, they create a closed shape called a triangle. These three intersecting points become the corners, or vertices!

Here is a magical rule of the universe: If you measure the three inside angles of absolutely ANY triangle, whether it is tiny or the size of a mountain, they will always add up to exactly 180 degrees!
If you extend one side of a triangle outside its boundary, you create an exterior angle. This outside angle is always exactly equal to the sum of the two interior angles farthest away from it.

fun_activity.title: 🧩 The Digroz Paper Corner Challenge
fun_activity.instructions: Cut a large triangle out of paper. Tear off all three corners and place their tips together side-by-side. You will see they form a perfect straight line, proving the 180-degree rule!

quick_recap: ⭐ A triangle is formed by three intersecting lines creating three vertices.
⭐ The sum of all three interior angles is always 180 degrees.
⭐ An exterior angle equals the sum of its two opposite interior angles.
